title: Brixton Supply Trade Mark Cap Hat Adult OSFA Snapback Black Adjustable Embroider
descriptionText:
This Brixton Supply Trade Mark Cap Hat is a must-have for any fashion-forward man. With its adjustable design, it's perfect for any head size and occasion, whether it's for travel, casual wear, or work. The black canvas fabric, made of a blend of wool and acrylic materials, gives it a stylish and durable look. 

The snapback style and adjustable features make it easy to wear and comfortable for all-day wear. The hat is embroidered with the Brixton brand, adding a touch of sophistication to the design. Whether you're running errands or going out with friends, this hat is the perfect accessory to complete your outfit.
